rules.title: Berkeley ban on coordinated rent-pricing algorithms
rules.requirement: Berkeley landlords may not use coordinated pricing algorithms to set rents. Tenants have private remedies, and each unit and each month of use can count as a separate violation.

coverage.summary: All rental units in Berkeley; the ban applies to any landlord using coordinated pricing algorithms.

rules.penalty: Recurring unit/month violations and private remedies (amounts not stated in this source).
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits coordinated pricing algorithms; recurring unit/month violations and private remedies, previously at issue in RealPage, Inc. v. City of Berkeley et al., (N.D. Cal.) (voluntarily dismissed with prejudice Jan. 14, 2026).
rules.conflict_note: Secondary law-firm source gives the effective date only as 'January 2026' (no exact day). The brief flags Berkeley's effective date as an open question, so verify against the ordinance text.

rules.title: San Francisco ban on algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data
rules.requirement: San Francisco landlords may not use algorithmic devices that rely on nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy. Tenants may sue for damages, an injunction and civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, with each unit and each month of use a separate violation.
rules.key_value: up to $1,000 per violation, per unit per month

coverage.summary: All rental units in San Francisco.

rules.penalty: Damages, injunctive relief, civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation; each month per affected unit may be a separate violation.
rules.quoted_span: The ordinance prohibits landlords from using qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy.

rules.title: San Diego ban on algorithmic rent-setting using competitor data
rules.requirement: San Diego landlords may not use prohibited algorithmic rent-pricing products. Tenants may sue for damages, an injunction and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and each affected property potentially a separate violation.

coverage.summary: All rental properties in San Diego.

rules.penalty: Damages, injunctive relief, penalties up to $1,000 per violation; each month and affected rental property may be a separate violation.
rules.quoted_span: San Diego similarly authorizes tenant suits for damages, injunctive relief and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and affected rental property potentially constituting a separate violation.

rules.title: Santa Ana ban on automated rent price-fixing
rules.requirement: Santa Ana prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing. Tenants can bring claims for up to $1,000 per violation, per month.
rules.key_value: up to $1,000 per violation and per month

coverage.summary: All rental units in Santa Ana.

rules.penalty: Private tenant claims up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.quoted_span: Ordinance NS-3090 prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.

rules.title: Jersey City ban on algorithmic rent coordination services
rules.requirement: Jersey City landlords may not use algorithmic rent coordination services. The ban is enforced by the city and by private parties, with fines of up to $2,000 per day.

coverage.summary: All rental units in Jersey City.

rules.penalty: Public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits a landlord’s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.

rules.title: Hoboken ban on rent-coordination software and data sharing
rules.requirement: Hoboken landlords may not use software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms or occupancy.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.

notes: Secondary law-firm alert. Effective dates are given only as month and year (e.g. 'January 2026'), so effective_date is left null except for Santa Ana (April 2, 2026). The Berkeley effective date remains unverified and is flagged for review. Ordinances outside CA, NJ and MA were omitted as outside the navigator's jurisdictions: Philadelphia, Minneapolis, Providence, Seattle, King County, Spokane, Portland and Rockville.
